visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 accurately shows the stated projectile setup with trajectory, axes, velocity components, angle, and relevant vertical-motion equation, while Lesson 1 is more generic and its mid-frame emphasizes a component value with oversized decorative arrows and an unclear triangle that is less positionally tied to the actual range problem.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 2 includes a well-formed, wired fill-in gate with a real prompt, acceptable answers, hints, and placement after a specific act, while Lesson 1 has no available gate specs or plan and therefore no functioning checkpoint evidence.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 2 has clear, natural narration with spoken math and no visible TTS defects, while Lesson 1 has no available narration transcript and therefore cannot demonstrate acceptable audio quality.

sync.rationale: Lesson 2 provides timed cues that mostly coincide with the narrated references, while Lesson 1 has no transcript or cue timing at all, making it impossible to verify any synchronization and therefore clearly worse on this dimension.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 correctly teaches the range problem through velocity decomposition, vertical flight time, and horizontal motion with the correct 141.4 m result, while Lesson 1 provides no transcript or lesson content at all, so it offers no assessable explanation or pedagogical support.

polish.rationale: Lesson 1 has large, highly legible typography and a cohesive hand-drawn visual style with a relatively clean centered composition, while Lesson 2’s mid-lesson frame is poorly balanced with tiny/dim diagram labels, excessive empty space, visible player controls, and important visuals pushed into the lower-left corner.

aggregator.explanation: Lesson 2 is the clear overall winner, taking five of six dimensions with very high confidence: visual accuracy, interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and concept accuracy. These wins indicate that Lesson 2 provides the correct projectile setup, functioning learner checkpoint, clear narration, aligned timing, and accurate instructional content. Lesson 1 only wins polish, with strong confidence, due to more legible typography and cleaner composition, but that single advantage is outweighed by Lesson 2’s broad and high-confidence superiority across the core instructional dimensions.
